name: Site Admin copies or shares invite link
title: SC-04-02-01 Site Admin copies or shares invite link
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the Site Manager taps "Davet Linki"
When the modal opens
Then display the invitation URL with copy and WhatsApp share buttons
And tapping "Linki Kopyala" copies the URL to the clipboard with confirmation
